findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: funciones.html, index.html, reel.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.
